attributes.context: Article VI assigns operation, maintenance, repair, assembly, and disassembly of power equipment on building and construction work to bargaining unit employees and states that new or unlisted equipment within the IUOE jurisdiction may have no wage rate listed in the Agreement.

extraction_text: Section 6.2. NEW OR UNLISTED EQUIPMENT: Should new or unlisted equipment within the claimed jurisdiction of the International Union of Operating Engineers be utilized for which no wage rate appears in this Agreement, the Union and the Association, acting on behalf of all the Contractors party to this Agreement, shall meet and agree on the wage rate to be paid for its operation.

attributes.context: The text is in the fringe benefit funds article and addresses PAC fund deductions tied to an internet-based reporting system; it specifies the deduction amount, effective date, and that deductions require individually signed voluntary authorization forms.

extraction_text: If the Local 139 Fringe Benefit Funds implement an "Internet Based Fringe Benefit Reporting" system, effective June 1, 2009, the Employer agrees to deduct five (5¢) cents for each hour that the employee receives wages under the terms of the Agreement, on the basis of individually signed, voluntarily executed authorized deduction forms which shall be provided to the Employer.
